changelog:
Initial release of publish-to-wechat:

- Publish Markdown articles to WeChat Official Accounts using Wenyan CLI.
- Automatically formats articles: supports built-in themes, code highlighting, and custom CSS injection.
- Parses and uploads images in Markdown (local or web) directly to the WeChat media library.
- Metadata-driven publishing: extracts title, cover, author, and source URL from YAML Frontmatter.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and command examples for quick use.
summary: AI-ready skill to format and publish Markdown articles to WeChat Official Accounts using Wenyan CLI.
